text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Early summer is here, and bit by bit, I'm 
hitting my stride as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm just getting started! Lemme show you what I can really do!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No change in my time, huh... Guess I hit 
the gas a little too late.
choice_data_list: Wanna run it one more time?
Wanna run it one more time?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Can I?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... Hmmm, I think I'll stop here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's almost the end of the day, and I've still 
got stuff to do... Yeah, 
let's continue 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll go put the equipment back. Catch you 
later, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes off with a smile, yet I can't quite 
shake a nagging feeling...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's just me, but I'm pretty sure she 
wants to continue running. 
Just what could 
be more important?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I thought you would've gone back by 
now.
choice_data_list: Thought I'd get some work done.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: M'kay, guess I'll clean your area later then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if on autopilot, she begins cleaning my 
office like she's done it a 
million times.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah, we're almost out of printer 
paper! I better swing by the 
supplies room 
before heading back.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, so many dust bunnies! I'm coming 
to get ya! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, the office is 
always clean, and the supplies 
never run 
out...
choice_data_list: You've been the one maintaining it!?
You were taking care of it!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help it—clutter gets under my 
skin! I wanna keep our shared 
space spick 
and span, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I don't appreciate it, but I'd 
rather she use this time to hit 
the track 
instead.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'll do it from now on!
Sorry, I'll do it from now on!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You mean... by yourself? Without any 
help?
choice_data_list: Yeah, want you to run more.
Yeah, to give you more running time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You mean... by yourself? Without any 
help?
choice_data_list: Yeah, want you to run more.
Yeah, to give you more running time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well... let's see what you've got, 
then! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's just cleaning. How hard can it be?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the dustcloth is over there! And if 
you're looking for the broom 
and dustpan, 
they're over in the corner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That goes on this shelf! It's best to keep 
them all neatly together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You can find spares for those over there. If 
you run out, just ask the 
supplies guy for 
more!
choice_data_list: T-This is harder than I thought...!
T-This is harder than I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you got this, you got this! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Ines Fujin's guidance, I somehow 
manage to finish cleaning. 
But...
choice_data_list: I leaned on Ines in the end...!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Impressed? This is the result of 
years spent elbow-deep in 
chores! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I feel bad making you do all the 
grunt work, so let's do it 
together from 
now on. After all, this is our special 
hangout!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, turn that frown upside down! C'mon, 
I made some tea, so let's 
take a break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to prove that she could rely on 
me, but in the end, she's the 
one saving 
me like a knight in shining armor.
